outcome: causative pathogen of urinary tract infection
cohort: Neonates delivered in a tertiary academic pediatric hospital and diagnosed with urinary tract infections between January 1, 2013 and December 31, 2017.
finding: Neonates born via cesarean section had a significantly higher prevalence of non-Escherichia coli urinary tract infections.
mod_finding: Neonates born via cesarean section had a significantly higher prevalence of non-Escherichia coli urinary tract infections.
